decisions.reason: The existing same-message FAQ update omits the change from weighted allocation to assignment to the owner of a randomly selected eligible NFT.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, 34 mints should correspond to 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

A mint still produces a ticket and commission even when no referral code is supplied.

Accounting works correctly on the leaderboards and NFT attributes whenever a code is used. That part is perfect.

Without a referral code, the ticket and commission are assigned randomly, but both must still appear on the leaderboard and in the NFT attributes.

Since your latest fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 7 mints seem to have been recorded correctly, which is great. The earlier missing tickets have not been backfilled, though.

The $18 commissions generated by these no-code buys are also still missing from the leaderboard and NFT attributes.

My screenshot shows an NFT with 9 tickets but only 4 x $20 commissions. That should be impossible because every ticket comes with a $18 commission.

The leaderboard screenshot accounts for only 15 tickets and 12 x $8 commissions from 34 total mints. Regardless of whether a referral code was supplied, 34 mints should produce 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

value_updates.approved_faq_copy: Use the approved FAQ copy with coded-referral commission references updated from $10 to $20.
value_updates.fiat_buyer_rewards_faq_section: Revise the fiat-buyer FAQ to explain automatic Transak creation of a non-custodial wallet without an initial seed phrase, automatic $20 coded-referral commissions, one ticket per referral for the current $900 draw every 750 sales, immediate wallet payout for winners, dashboard and email notifications, and step-by-step guidance for viewing or converting funds.
value_updates.beginner_rewards_collection_faq_section: Add a beginner section explaining automatic $20 coded-referral commission tracking and payout, mint-number referral codes, automatic on-chain ticket assignment to the NFT, Chainlink VRF winner selection, current-draw ticket expiration, and immediate $900 wallet payout with dashboard and email notifications.
value_updates.no_referral_rewards_faq_section: State that a referral-free purchase creates six tickets and commission, with both assigned to the owner of a randomly selected eligible NFT.

decisions.reason: The source recipient-selection change applies only when no referral code is supplied and does not alter coded-referral recipient selection.
The landing-page state contains coded-referral commission copy but no current no-referral recipient-selection statement requiring revision.
The source changes no-referral commission allocation and does not alter ticket issuance to the NFT associated with an accepted referral code.
Changing the recipient selection for no-referral commissions does not alter how an NFT's referral code is derived, persisted, or displayed.
The metadata requirement already requires randomly distributed commissions to appear in NFT attributes; the recipient-selection change does not alter that visibility rule.
The source does not change referral-code eligibility or the prohibition on self-referrals.
Selection of a no-referral commission recipient does not change Small Block winners, prize amounts, draw triggers, or pool funding.
The source Event changes who receives a no-referral commission, not the mint price or top-level revenue-allocation amounts.
The no-referral commission recipient-selection change does not alter any transactional email channel or required email content.
